verses.text: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!

segments.text: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!

verses.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!

segments.text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!

verses.text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

segments.text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
